goal: Implement the Identity domain layer: User aggregate with password validation, Credentials value object with bcrypt hashing, RefreshToken entity, repository interfaces, and database migrations for users + refresh_tokens tables.

tasks.name: User aggregate + Credentials value object
tasks.action: Implement the User entity and Credentials value object in internal/identity/domain/user/. User has ID, Email, DisplayName, PasswordHash, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt. Credentials handles password validation (8+ chars, uppercase, lowercase, number, special char) and bcrypt hashing/verification. UserRepository interface.
microSteps: Implement user.go: User struct (ID uuid.UUID, Email string, PasswordHash string, DisplayName string, CreatedAt time.Time, UpdatedAt time.Time), NewUser constructor validating email + display name

Implement credentials.go: ValidatePassword(plain string) error enforcing 8+ chars, uppercase, lowercase, digit, special char. HashPassword(plain string) (string, error) using bcrypt cost=10. CheckPassword(hash, plain string) error using bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword
Write credentials_test.go: table-driven tests for password validation (valid, too short, missing uppercase, missing digit, etc.), hash+verify round-trip, wrong password rejection
Write user_test.go: test NewUser with valid/invalid inputs
Implement repository.go: UserRepository interface with Create, GetByID, GetByEmail, Update methods

tasks.name: RefreshToken entity + SessionRepository interface
tasks.action: Implement RefreshToken entity in internal/identity/domain/session/. Handles token generation (crypto/rand), hashing (SHA-256), expiry checking, and revocation. SessionRepository interface.
microSteps: Implement session.go: RefreshToken struct (ID, UserID, TokenHash, ExpiresAt, Revoked, CreatedAt). GenerateToken() (rawToken string, hashedToken string, error) using crypto/rand for 32 bytes + SHA-256 hash. IsExpired() bool. IsRevoked() bool. NewRefreshToken(userID, rawToken, ttl) constructor
Write session_test.go: test token generation (raw != hash), expiry checking, revocation state
Implement repository.go: SessionRepository interface with Create, GetByTokenHash, RevokeByID, RevokeAllForUser methods

tasks.name: Database migrations (users + refresh_tokens)
tasks.action: Create SQL migration files for the users and refresh_tokens tables.
verify: test -f migrations/003_users.up.sql && grep 'CREATE TABLE users' migrations/003_users.up.sql
test -f migrations/004_refresh_tokens.up.sql && grep 'CREATE TABLE refresh_tokens' migrations/004_refresh_tokens.up.sql
microSteps: Create 003_users.up.sql: users table (id UUID PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, display_name TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()). Index on email.
Create 003_users.down.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users

Create 004_refresh_tokens.up.sql: refresh_tokens table (id UUID PK, user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, revoked BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()). Indexes on user_id and token_hash.
Create 004_refresh_tokens.down.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS refresh_tokens

tdd.reason: SQL migration files — verified by file existence and content grep. Integration test requires running PostgreSQL.

commitMessage: feat(identity): domain layer — User aggregate, Credentials, RefreshToken, migrations
